settings.noise: per-observation reported variance plus fitted shared additional Gaussian variance
settings.nomination: highest posterior mean among visited locations

caveats: Control spread includes fit error, drift, retuning and session changes; it is not an identified noise variance.
No inferred persistence time, covariance, burst probability or causal shielding model.
Control noise scales at one bias do not establish global spatial dependence.

nonstationary.assumptions: Geometric regime durations, AR(1) bias/baseline, decaying bursts; coefficients not fitted to temporal controls.
nonstationary.clock: Fixed empirical median acquisition duration per evaluation; no API latency or explicit retuning cost.

environment_provenance.qc_model: thresholds on synthetic baseline and environment-degraded local R2 templates
environment_provenance.noise_model: persistent environmental bias, changing Gaussian scale and burst episodes
environment_provenance.caveat: No landscape is verified physical truth; noise and QC models are exploratory.
